podcast.title: Jerry Cantrell Collaboration
podcast.body: The band opened for one of Jerry Cantrell's solo tours around 2002 and also served as his backing band on that tour, fostering a friendship that led to William DuVall joining Alice in Chains. "Later, the band opened for one of Cantrell solo tours. This would be about 2002. In fact, Come With The Fall also function as Jerry's backing band on that solo tour."

podcast.title: William DuVall's Band
podcast.body: William DuVall was the singer for the group Comes with the Fall when he was invited to be a guest vocalist for Alice in Chains in March 2006, eventually leading to him joining Alice in Chains full-time. "One of the guest vocalists that evening was a guy named William Duval, the singer with a group called Comes with the Fall."

xref.title: Layne Staley Found Dead April 19, 2002; William DuVall Joined, Three Albums Followed
xref.body: Layne Staley was the person around whom Alice in Chains was originally formed in 1984. By 1995, heroin had rendered him almost unable to function; the band could neither record nor tour. His body was found on April 19, 2002, in his Seattle condo after two weeks of no contact, still with a syringe in its arm. After a 2004 tsunami benefit with various substitute vocalists, the band decided to continue and eventually settled on William DuVall from a Los Angeles band called Comes with the Fall — who could blend his voice with guitarist Jerry Cantrell's harmonics and was also a capable guitarist. Three Alice in Chains albums followed. "He was also a pretty fair guitar player."

xref.title: William DuVall Joins as Lead Vocalist
xref.body: Following a successful show in March 2006, where William DuVall (singer for Comes with the Fall) performed as a guest vocalist, the band considered him for a permanent role. They had known and respected DuVall for five or six years. Other candidates, like Vinny Dombrowski of Sponge, were considered but didn't fit, and Scott Weiland was deemed unsuitable due to his drug issues. DuVall was chosen because he sounded close to Layne Staley without being a clone. His integration was gradual, leading to a full commitment by late 2008. "One of the guest vocalists that evening was a guy named William Duval, the singer with a group called Comes with the Fall."
